_comment: Example schema showing reminder storage and Slack Lists integration

reminder_storage._description: Array of ReminderInfo objects stored locally

example.ReminderMessageText: Add a new feature to Slack Lists

field_definitions.ReminderID: UUID - unique identifier for the reminder
field_definitions.CreatedOn: ISO 8601 timestamp - when reminder was created
field_definitions.ShouldPostOn: ISO 8601 timestamp - when reminder should be posted
field_definitions.TargetChannelID: Slack channel ID - where reminder will be posted
field_definitions.OriginalChannelID: Slack channel ID - where original message was
field_definitions.OriginalMessageID: Slack message timestamp - original message ts
field_definitions.OriginalSenderID: Slack user ID - who requested the reminder
field_definitions.IgnoreSnooze: Boolean - if true, post even during snooze hours

lists_cache._description: Cache mapping reminders to Slack List items

field_definitions.listId: Slack List ID - the F-prefixed list identifier
field_definitions.itemCache: Object mapping ReminderID -> Slack List item ID (Rec-prefixed)
field_definitions.lastSync: ISO 8601 timestamp - when cache was last synced
field_definitions.listSchema: Object mapping field names to Slack column IDs (Col-prefixed)

slack_list_item_creation._description: Format used when creating items via slackLists.items.create API

elements.text: Add a new feature to Slack Lists

slack_list_item_response._description: Format returned by slackLists.items.list API (needs transformation)

elements.text: Add a new feature to Slack Lists

slack_list_item_response._note: The fields array format requires transformation to flat object for validation

transformed_list_item._description: Internal format after #TransformListItem() converts API response

elements.text: Add a new feature to Slack Lists

validated_list_item._description: Final format after #ValidateListItem() parses and validates fields

example.summary: Add a new feature to Slack Lists
example.fullMessage: Add a new feature to Slack Lists

slack_list_schema._description: Column definitions used when creating a new Slack List

data_flow._description: How data flows between reminder storage and Slack Lists
write_flow: 1. ReminderInfo created with ReminderMessageText (may contain mrkdwn)
3. AddReminderToListAsync() creates item with initial_fields array
4. Slack returns item with fields array and Rec-prefixed ID
read_flow: 1. slackLists.items.list returns items with fields array
2. #TransformListItem() converts fields array to flat object
4. Validated data compared against reminder storage for sync
